import { BrowserRouter, Routes, Route, Navigate } from "react-router-dom";
import AdminLayoutClient from "./components/layout/AdminLayoutClient";
import DashboardPage from "./pages/DashboardPage";
import TestPage from "./pages/TestPage";
import ModulePage from "./pages/ModulePage";

export default function App() {
  return (
    <BrowserRouter>
      <AdminLayoutClient>
        <Routes>
          {/* Root redirects to /dashboard */}
          <Route path="/" element={<Navigate to="/dashboard" replace />} />
          
          {/* Dashboard utama */}
          <Route path="/dashboard" element={<DashboardPage />} />

          {/* Test Page dari template Next.js */}
          <Route path="/test" element={<TestPage />} />

          {/* Seluruh sub-modul perencanaan, penganggaran, monev, referensi, dan administrasi */}
          <Route path="*" element={<ModulePage />} />
        </Routes>
      </AdminLayoutClient>
    </BrowserRouter>
  );
}

import { useState, useRef, useEffect } from "react";
import {
  User,
  Settings,
  LogOut,
  ChevronDown,
  Shield,
  Bell,
} from "lucide-react";

// Dummy user data
const dummyUser = {
  name: "Budi Santoso, S.Sos",
  role: "Admin Perencanaan",
  opd: "Bappeda",
  initials: "BS",
  email: "budi.santoso@bappeda.go.id",
  isOnline: true,
};

export default function UserMenu() {
  const [isOpen, setIsOpen] = useState(false);
  const ref = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  // Close dropdown when clicking outside
  useEffect(() => {
    const handler = (e: MouseEvent) => {
      if (ref.current && !ref.current.contains(e.target as Node)) {
        setIsOpen(false);
      }
    };
    document.addEventListener("mousedown", handler);
    return () => document.removeEventListener("mousedown", handler);
  }, []);

  return (
    <div className="relative" ref={ref}>
      {/* Trigger button */}
      <button
        onClick={() => setIsOpen(!isOpen)}
        className="flex items-center gap-2.5 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl hover:bg-[var(--accent)] border border-transparent hover:border-[var(--border)] transition-all duration-200 focus:outline-none cursor-pointer"
        aria-expanded={isOpen}
        aria-haspopup="true"
      >
        {/* Avatar */}
        <div className="relative flex-shrink-0">
          <div className="w-8 h-8 rounded-full bg-[var(--primary-bg)] flex items-center justify-center">
            <span className="text-[var(--primary)] text-xs font-bold">
              {dummyUser.initials}
            </span>
          </div>
          {/* Online dot */}
          {dummyUser.isOnline && (
            <span className="absolute bottom-0 right-0 w-2 h-2 bg-green-500 rounded-full border-2 border-[var(--card)]" />
          )}
        </div>

        {/* Name (hide on small screens) */}
        <div className="hidden md:flex flex-col text-left leading-tight">
          <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-[var(--text)] truncate max-w-[140px]">
            {dummyUser.name}
          </span>
          <span className="text-[0.65rem] text-[var(--text-muted)]">
            {dummyUser.role} · {dummyUser.opd}
          </span>
        </div>

        <ChevronDown
          className={`h-3.5 w-3.5 text-[var(--text-muted)] transition-transform duration-200 ${
            isOpen ? "rotate-180" : ""
          }`}
        />
      </button>

      {/* Dropdown */}
      {isOpen && (
        <div className="absolute right-0 top-full mt-2 w-64 aksi-card shadow-xl shadow-black/10 dark:shadow-black/40 z-50 overflow-hidden">
          {/* User info header */}
          <div className="px-4 py-3 border-b border-[var(--border)] bg-[var(--accent)]/50">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
              <div className="relative flex-shrink-0">
                <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-full bg-[var(--primary-bg)] flex items-center justify-center">
                  <span className="text-[var(--primary)] text-sm font-bold">
                    {dummyUser.initials}
                  </span>
                </div>
                {dummyUser.isOnline && (
                  <span className="absolute bottom-0 right-0 w-2.5 h-2.5 bg-green-500 rounded-full border-2 border-[var(--card)]" />
                )}
              </div>
              <div className="min-w-0">
                <p className="text-sm font-semibold text-[var(--text)] truncate">
                  {dummyUser.name}
                </p>
                <p className="text-xs text-[var(--text-muted)] truncate">
                  {dummyUser.email}
                </p>
                <div className="flex items-center gap-1 mt-0.5">

                  <span className="text-[0.65rem] text-[var(--primary)] font-medium">

            >

}

function DropdownItem({
  icon: Icon,
  label,
  href,
  badge,
}: {
  icon: React.ComponentType<{ className?: string }>;
  label: string;
  href: string;
  badge?: string;
}) {
  return (
    <a
      href={href}
      className="flex items-center gap-3 px-4 py-2 text-sm text-[var(--text)] hover:bg-[var(--accent)] transition-colors"
      onClick={(e) => {
        if (href.startsWith("#")) {
          e.preventDefault();
        }
      }}
    >
      <Icon className="h-4 w-4 text-[var(--text-muted)]" />
      <span className="flex-1">{label}</span>
      {badge && <span className="badge badge-red">{badge}</span>}
    </a>
  );
}


=== FILE: apps/web/src/components/ui/ServerClock.tsx ===
import { useState, useEffect } from "react";

export default function ServerClock() {
  const [now, setNow] = useState<Date | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    // Set initial time on client only (avoid SSR mismatch)
    setNow(new Date());
    const timer = setInterval(() => setNow(new Date()), 1000);
    return () => clearInterval(timer);
  }, []);

  if (!now) {
    // Placeholder saat loading / sebelum mount
    return (
      <div className="flex flex-col">
        <span className="text-[0.65rem] text-[var(--text-muted)] leading-none">Memuat...</span>
      </div>
    );
  }

  const dateStr = now.toLocaleDateString("id-ID", {
    weekday: "short",
    day: "2-digit",
    month: "short",
    year: "numeric",
  });

  const timeStr = now.toLocaleTimeString("id-ID", {
    hour: "2-digit",
    minute: "2-digit",
    second: "2-digit",
    hour12: false,
  });

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col leading-tight">
      <span className="text-[0.7rem] text-[var(--text-muted)] font-medium">{dateStr}</span>
      <span className="text-sm font-bold text-[var(--text)] tabular-nums">{timeStr}</span>
    </div>
  );
}


=== FILE: apps/web/src/components/ui/ThemeToggle.tsx ===
import { useState, useEffect } from "react";
import { Sun, Moon } from "lucide-react";

export default function ThemeToggle() {
  const [isDark, setIsDark] = useState(false);

  // Sinkronisasi dengan theme yang sudah di-set oleh ThemeInitScript
  useEffect(() => {
    const html = document.documentElement;
    setIsDark(html.classList.contains("dark"));

    // Observe perubahan class di html (misal dari toggle lain)
    const observer = new MutationObserver(() => {
      setIsDark(document.documentElement.classList.contains("dark"));
    });
    observer.observe(html, { attributes: true, attributeFilter: ["class"] });
    return () => observer.disconnect();
  }, []);

  const toggle = () => {
    const html = document.documentElement;
    const newDark = !isDark;
    html.classList.remove("light", "dark");
    html.classList.add(newDark ? "dark" : "light");
    localStorage.setItem("aksi-theme", newDark ? "dark" : "light");
    setIsDark(newDark);
  };

  return (
    <button
      onClick={toggle}
      aria-label={isDark ? "Aktifkan mode terang" : "Aktifkan mode gelap"}
      title={isDark ? "Mode Terang" : "Mode Gelap"}
      className={`
        relative flex items-center w-12 h-6 rounded-full border transition-all duration-300
        focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[var(--primary)] focus:ring-offset-1 cursor-pointer
        ${isDark
          ? "bg-slate-700 border-slate-600"
          : "bg-slate-100 border-slate-200"
        }
      `}
    >
      {/* Sun icon */}
      <Sun className={`absolute left-1 h-3.5 w-3.5 transition-all duration-300 ${isDark ? "opacity-20 text-slate-400" : "opacity-100 text-amber-500"}`} />
      {/* Moon icon */}
      <Moon className={`absolute right-1 h-3.5 w-3.5 transition-all duration-300 ${isDark ? "opacity-100 text-blue-400" : "opacity-20 text-slate-400"}`} />
      {/* Thumb */}
      <span
        className={`
          absolute w-4 h-4 rounded-full shadow-sm transition-all duration-300
          ${isDark ? "translate-x-7 bg-blue-400" : "translate-x-1 bg-white"}
        `}
      />
    </button>
  );
}


=== FILE: apps/web/src/components/ui/ThemeInitScript.tsx ===
/**
 * Script ini dijalankan sebelum React hydration untuk menghindari
 * "flash of wrong theme" (FOWT). Diinjeksikan langsung ke <head>.
 */
export default function ThemeInitScript() {
  const script = `
    (function() {
      try {
        var saved = localStorage.getItem('aksi-theme');
        var prefersDark = window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)').matches;
        var theme = saved || (prefersDark ? 'dark' : 'light');
        var html = document.documentElement;
        html.classList.remove('light', 'dark');
        html.classList.add(theme);
      } catch(e) {
        document.documentElement.classList.add('light');
      }
    })();
  `;
  return <script dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: script }} />;
}


=== FILE: apps/web/src/components/layout/Sidebar.tsx ===
import { useEffect, useState, useMemo } from "react";
import { Link } from "react-router-dom";
import { X, Search } from "lucide-react";
import NavGroup from "../navigation/NavGroup";
import { menuConfig, type MenuGroup } from "../navigation/menuConfig";

interface SidebarProps {
  collapsed: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
}

export default function Sidebar({ collapsed, onClose }: SidebarProps) {
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState("");

  // Tutup sidebar mobile saat tekan Escape
  useEffect(() => {
    const handler = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (e.key === "Escape" && !collapsed) onClose();
    };
    document.addEventListener("keydown", handler);
    return () => document.removeEventListener("keydown", handler);
  }, [onClose, collapsed]);

  // Filtered menu items when searching
  const filteredGroups = useMemo(() => {
    if (!searchQuery.trim()) return menuConfig;
    const q = searchQuery.toLowerCase();

    return menuConfig
      .map((group) => {
        const matchingItems = group.items.filter((item) => {
          const matchItem = item.label.toLowerCase().includes(q);
          const matchSub = item.submenu?.some((sub) =>
            sub.label.toLowerCase().includes(q)
          );
          return matchItem || matchSub;
        });

        return {
          ...group,
          items: matchingItems,
        };
      })
      .filter((group) => group.items.length > 0) as MenuGroup[];
  }, [searchQuery]);

  return (
    <>
      {/* ── Mobile overlay backdrop ── */}
      <div
        className={`
          fixed inset-0 z-30 bg-black/50 backdrop-blur-sm
          lg:hidden transition-opacity duration-300
          ${!collapsed ? "opacity-100 pointer-events-auto" : "opacity-0 pointer-events-none"}
        `}
        onClick={onClose}
        aria-hidden="true"
      />

      {/* ── Sidebar panel ── */}
      <aside
        className={`
          fixed top-0 left-0 z-40 h-screen flex flex-col
          lg:relative lg:top-auto lg:left-auto lg:h-full lg:z-auto
          bg-[var(--sidebar-bg)] border-r border-[var(--border)]
          transition-all duration-300 ease-in-out overflow-hidden
          ${collapsed
            ? "-translate-x-full lg:translate-x-0 w-72 lg:w-16"
            : "translate-x-0 w-72"
          }
        `}
        aria-label="Navigasi utama"
      >

        {/* ── Header / Logo ── */}
        <div
          className={`
            flex items-center border-b border-[var(--border)] flex-shrink-0 h-14
            transition-all duration-300
            ${collapsed ? "lg:justify-center px-3" : "px-4 justify-between"}
          `}
        >
          {/* Logo link (full) */}
          <Link
            to="/dashboard"
            className={`flex items-center gap-3 group ${collapsed ? "lg:hidden" : ""}`}
          >
            <div className="w-8 h-8 rounded-xl bg-[var(--primary)] flex items-center justify-center shadow-md flex-shrink-0">
              <span className="text-white font-bold text-sm">A</span>
            </div>
            <div className="leading-tight">
              <p className="text-sm font-bold text-[var(--text)] group-hover:text-[var(--primary)] transition-colors">
                AKSI
              </p>
              <p className="text-[0.6rem] text-[var(--text-muted)] leading-none">
                Perencanaan & Penganggaran
              </p>
            </div>
          </Link>

          {/* Logo icon only (collapsed desktop) */}
          <Link
            to="/dashboard"
            title="AKSI - Dashboard"
            className={`hidden group ${collapsed ? "lg:flex" : ""}`}
          >
            <div className="w-8 h-8 rounded-xl bg-[var(--primary)] flex items-center justify-center shadow-md">
              <span className="text-white font-bold text-sm">A</span>
            </div>
          </Link>

          {/* Close button (mobile) */}
          <button
            onClick={onClose}
            className={`lg:hidden p-1.5 rounded-lg hover:bg-[var(--accent)] text-[var(--text-muted)] transition-colors cursor-pointer ${collapsed ? "hidden" : ""}`}
            aria-label="Tutup sidebar"
          >
            <X className="h-4 w-4" />
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* ── Search Box (hidden when collapsed on desktop) ── */}
        <div className={`px-3 py-3 flex-shrink-0 ${collapsed ? "lg:hidden" : ""}`}>
          <div className="relative">
            <Search className="absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 h-4 w-4 text-[var(--text-muted)]" />
            <input
              type="text"
              value={searchQuery}
              onChange={(e) => setSearchQuery(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="Cari menu..."
              className="w-full pl-9 pr-4 py-2 text-sm rounded-xl border border-[var(--border)] bg-[var(--accent)] text-[var(--text)] placeholder:text-[var(--text-muted)] focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[var(--primary)] focus:border-transparent transition-all"
            />
            {searchQuery && (
              <button
                onClick={() => setSearchQuery("")}
                className="absolute right-2.5 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-xs text-[var(--text-muted)] hover:text-[var(--text)]"
              >
                ✕
              </button>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Search icon only (collapsed desktop) */}
        <div className={`hidden px-3 py-3 flex-shrink-0 ${collapsed ? "lg:flex justify-center" : ""}`}>
          <button
            title="Cari menu"
            className="p-2 rounded-xl hover:bg-[var(--accent)] text-[var(--text-muted)] transition-colors cursor-pointer"
          >
            <Search className="h-4 w-4" />
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* ── Navigation ── */}
        <nav className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto overflow-x-hidden px-2 pb-4">
          {filteredGroups.length === 0 ? (
            <div className="px-3 py-6 text-center text-xs text-[var(--text-muted)]">
              Tidak ada menu ditemukan
            </div>
          ) : (
            filteredGroups.map((group) => (
              <NavGroup
                key={group.groupLabel}
                group={group}
                collapsed={collapsed}
              />
            ))
          )}
        </nav>

        {/* ── Footer ── */}
        <div
          className={`
            flex-shrink-0 border-t border-[var(--border)] px-3 py-3
            ${collapsed ? "lg:hidden" : ""}
          `}
        >
          <p className="text-[0.6rem] text-[var(--text-muted)] text-center">
            AKSI v1.0.0 · TA{" "}
            <span className="text-[var(--primary)] font-semibold">2026</span>
          </p>
        </div>
      </aside>
    </>
  );
}

=== FILE: apps/web/src/components/layout/AdminLayoutClient.tsx ===
import { useState } from "react";
import Sidebar from "./Sidebar";
import Topbar from "./Topbar";

export default function AdminLayoutClient({
  children,
}: {
  children: React.ReactNode;
}) {
  /**
   * sidebarCollapsed:
   *  - Mobile (<lg): false = overlay terbuka, true = overlay tertutup
   *  - Desktop (>=lg): false = sidebar penuh (w-72), true = icon rail (w-16)
   */
  const [sidebarCollapsed, setSidebarCollapsed] = useState(false);

  const toggleSidebar = () => setSidebarCollapsed((prev) => !prev);

  return (
    <div className="flex h-screen overflow-hidden bg-[var(--bg)]">
      {/* Sidebar vertikal */}
      <Sidebar
        collapsed={sidebarCollapsed}
        onClose={() => setSidebarCollapsed(true)}
      />

      {/* Area kanan: topbar + konten */}
      <div className="flex flex-col flex-1 min-w-0 overflow-hidden">
        <Topbar
          onMenuToggle={toggleSidebar}
          sidebarCollapsed={sidebarCollapsed}
        />
        <main className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto p-4 md:p-6">
          {children}
        </main>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}


=== FILE: apps/web/src/components/navigation/NavItem.tsx ===
import { useState, useEffect } from "react";
import { useLocation, Link } from "react-router-dom";
import { ChevronDown } from "lucide-react";
import type { MenuItem } from "./menuConfig";

interface NavItemProps {
  item: MenuItem;
  collapsed?: boolean;
}

export default function NavItem({ item, collapsed = false }: NavItemProps) {
  const location = useLocation();
  const pathname = location.pathname;
  const hasSubmenu = item.submenu && item.submenu.length > 0;

  const isActive = item.href
    ? pathname === item.href
    : item.submenu?.some((sub) => pathname === sub.href) ?? false;

  const [isOpen, setIsOpen] = useState(isActive);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isActive) {
      setIsOpen(true);
    }
  }, [isActive]);

  const Icon = item.icon;

  // ══════════════════════════════════════════
  // COLLAPSED MODE (Desktop icon-rail only)
  // ══════════════════════════════════════════
  const collapsedItem = (
    <div className="hidden lg:block relative group/tooltip">
      {hasSubmenu ? (
        <button
          className={`
            sidebar-nav-item justify-center px-0 w-full cursor-pointer
            ${isActive ? "active" : ""}
          `}
          title={item.label}
          onClick={() => setIsOpen(!isOpen)}
          style={{ paddingLeft: 0, paddingRight: 0 }}
        >
          <span
            className={`
              flex-shrink-0 p-2 rounded-lg transition-colors
              ${isActive
                ? "bg-[var(--primary-bg)] text-[var(--primary)]"
                : "text-[var(--text-muted)] group-hover/tooltip:bg-[var(--primary-bg)] group-hover/tooltip:text-[var(--primary)]"
              }
            `}
          >
            <Icon className="h-5 w-5" />
          </span>
        </button>
      ) : (
        <Link
          to={item.href ?? "#"}
          title={item.label}
          className={`sidebar-nav-item justify-center px-0 ${isActive ? "active" : ""}`}
          style={{ paddingLeft: 0, paddingRight: 0 }}
        >
          <span
            className={`
              flex-shrink-0 p-2 rounded-lg transition-colors
              ${isActive
                ? "bg-[var(--primary-bg)] text-[var(--primary)]"
                : "text-[var(--text-muted)] group-hover/tooltip:bg-[var(--primary-bg)] group-hover/tooltip:text-[var(--primary)]"
              }
            `}
          >
            <Icon className="h-5 w-5" />
          </span>
        </Link>
      )}

      {/* Tooltip on hover */}
      <div className="
        absolute left-full top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 ml-2 z-50
        pointer-events-none opacity-0 group-hover/tooltip:opacity-100
        transition-opacity duration-150
      ">
        <div className="
          bg-[var(--card)] border border-[var(--border)] shadow-lg
          text-[var(--text)] text-xs font-medium
          px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-lg whitespace-nowrap
          flex items-center gap-1.5
        ">
          {item.label}
          {item.badge && (
            <span className={`badge badge-${item.badgeVariant ?? "gray"}`}>
              {item.badge}
            </span>
          )}
        </div>
        {/* Tooltip arrow */}
        <div className="absolute right-full top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 border-4 border-transparent border-r-[var(--border)]" />
      </div>
    </div>
  );

  // ══════════════════════════════════════════
  // FULL MODE (Mobile always, Desktop expanded)
  // ══════════════════════════════════════════

  // Item WITH submenu
  if (hasSubmenu) {
    return (
      <>
        {/* Icon-only (collapsed desktop) */}
        {collapsed && collapsedItem}

        {/* Full item */}
        <div className={collapsed ? "lg:hidden" : ""}>
          <button
            onClick={() => setIsOpen(!isOpen)}
            className={`sidebar-nav-item group w-full text-left cursor-pointer ${isActive ? "active" : ""}`}
            aria-expanded={isOpen}
          >
            {/* Icon */}
            <span
              className={`
                flex-shrink-0 p-1.5 rounded-lg mr-3 transition-colors
                ${isActive
                  ? "bg-[var(--primary-bg)] text-[var(--primary)]"
                  : "bg-[var(--accent)] text-[var(--text-muted)] group-hover:bg-[var(--primary-bg)] group-hover:text-[var(--primary)]"
                }
              `}
            >
              <Icon className="h-4 w-4" />
            </span>

            {/* Label */}
            <span className="flex-1 truncate text-left">{item.label}</span>

            {/* Badge */}
            {item.badge && (
              <span className={`badge badge-${item.badgeVariant ?? "gray"} mr-1`}>
                {item.badge}
              </span>
            )}

            {/* Chevron */}
            <ChevronDown
              className={`h-3.5 w-3.5 ml-1 text-[var(--text-muted)] transition-transform duration-200 flex-shrink-0 ${
                isOpen ? "rotate-180" : ""
              }`}
            />
          </button>

          {/* Submenu accordion */}
          <div
            className={`overflow-hidden transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out ${
              isOpen ? "max-h-96 opacity-100" : "max-h-0 opacity-0"
            }`}
          >
            <div className="mt-0.5 ml-4 pl-3 border-l border-[var(--border)] space-y-0.5 py-0.5">
              {item.submenu!.map((sub) => {
                const isSubActive = pathname === sub.href;
                return (
                  <Link
                    key={sub.href}
                    to={sub.href}
                    className={`
                      flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-2 rounded-lg text-xs font-medium transition-all
                      ${isSubActive
                        ? "text-[var(--primary)] bg-[var(--primary-bg)]"
                        : "text-[var(--text-muted)] hover:text-[var(--text)] hover:bg-[var(--accent)]"
                      }
                    `}
                  >
                    <span
                      className={`w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full flex-shrink-0 ${
                        isSubActive ? "bg-[var(--primary)]" : "bg-[var(--border)]"
                      }`}
                    />
                    <span className="flex-1">{sub.label}</span>
                    {sub.badge && (
                      <span className={`badge badge-${sub.badgeVariant ?? "gray"}`}>
                        {sub.badge}
                      </span>
                    )}
                  </Link>
                );
              })}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </>
    );
  }

  // Item WITHOUT submenu (simple link)
  return (
    <>
      {/* Icon-only (collapsed desktop) */}
      {collapsed && (
        <div className="hidden lg:block relative group/tooltip">
          <Link
            to={item.href ?? "#"}
            title={item.label}
            className={`sidebar-nav-item justify-center px-0 ${isActive ? "active" : ""}`}
            style={{ paddingLeft: 0, paddingRight: 0 }}
          >
            <span
              className={`
                flex-shrink-0 p-2 rounded-lg transition-colors
                ${isActive
                  ? "bg-[var(--primary-bg)] text-[var(--primary)]"
                  : "text-[var(--text-muted)] group-hover/tooltip:bg-[var(--primary-bg)] group-hover/tooltip:text-[var(--primary)]"
                }
              `}
            >
              <Icon className="h-5 w-5" />
            </span>
          </Link>
          {/* Tooltip */}
          <div className="
            absolute left-full top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 ml-2 z-50
            pointer-events-none opacity-0 group-hover/tooltip:opacity-100
            transition-opacity duration-150
          ">
            <div className="bg-[var(--card)] border border-[var(--border)] shadow-lg text-[var(--text)] text-xs font-medium px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-lg whitespace-nowrap">
              {item.label}
            </div>
            <div className="absolute right-full top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 border-4 border-transparent border-r-[var(--border)]" />
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Full item */}
      <Link
        to={item.href ?? "#"}
        className={`sidebar-nav-item group ${isActive ? "active" : ""} ${collapsed ? "lg:hidden" : ""}`}
      >
        <span
          className={`
            flex-shrink-0 p-1.5 rounded-lg mr-3 transition-colors
            ${isActive
              ? "bg-[var(--primary-bg)] text-[var(--primary)]"
              : "bg-[var(--accent)] text-[var(--text-muted)] group-hover:bg-[var(--primary-bg)] group-hover:text-[var(--primary)]"
            }
          `}
        >
          <Icon className="h-4 w-4" />
        </span>
        <span className="flex-1 truncate">{item.label}</span>
        {item.badge && (
          <span className={`badge badge-${item.badgeVariant ?? "gray"}`}>
            {item.badge}
          </span>
        )}
      </Link>
    </>
  );
}


=== FILE: apps/web/src/components/navigation/NavGroup.tsx ===
import NavItem from "./NavItem";
import type { MenuGroup } from "./menuConfig";

interface NavGroupProps {
  group: MenuGroup;
  collapsed?: boolean;
}

export default function NavGroup({ group, collapsed = false }: NavGroupProps) {
  return (
    <div className="mb-4">
      {/* Group label — hidden when collapsed on desktop */}
      <span
        className={`
          block px-2 mb-1.5 text-[0.6rem] font-semibold uppercase tracking-widest text-[var(--text-muted)]
          ${collapsed ? "lg:hidden" : ""}
        `}
      >
        {group.groupLabel}
      </span>

      {/* Divider line when collapsed (desktop only) */}
      {collapsed && (
        <div className="hidden lg:block w-6 h-px bg-[var(--border)] mx-auto mb-2" />
      )}

      <div className="space-y-0.5">
        {group.items.map((item) => (
          <NavItem key={item.label} item={item} collapsed={collapsed} />
        ))}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

// src/data/apiService.ts
// API Service for fetching reference data from PostgreSQL Backend

const API_BASE_URL = import.meta.env.VITE_API_URL || 'http://localhost:3000';

export interface ApiResponse<T> {
  success: boolean;
  message: string;
  data: T;
  pagination?: {
    total: number;
    page: number;
    limit: number;
    totalPages: number;
  };
}

export interface AkunBelanja {
  id: number;
  no: number;
  kelompokBelanja: string;
  kodeAkun3Digit: string;
  namaAkun3Digit: string;
  kodeAkun6Digit: string;
  uraianAkun: string;
  penggunaanSingkat: string;
  kelompokBarangJasa: string | null;
  kategori: string;
  createdAt: string;
  updatedAt: string;
}

export interface Pejabat {
  id: number;
  kodePejabat: string;
  nama: string;
  nip: string;
  jabatan: string;
  pangkat: string | null;
  unitKerja: string;
  email: string | null;
  roleTtd: string[] | null;
  status: string;
}

export interface Sbk {
  id: number;
  kode: string;
  nama: string;
  satuan: string;
  paguMaks: number;
  dasarHukum: string | null;
  keterangan: string | null;
}

class ApiService {
  private baseUrl: string;

  constructor(baseUrl: string) {
    this.baseUrl = baseUrl;
  }

  private async fetch<T>(endpoint: string, options?: RequestInit): Promise<T> {
    const url = `${this.baseUrl}${endpoint}`;
    const response = await fetch(url, {
      ...options,
      headers: {
        'Content-Type': 'application/json',
        ...options?.headers,
      },
    });

    if (!response.ok) {
      throw new Error(`API Error: ${response.status} ${response.statusText}`);
    }

    return response.json();
  }

  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  // BAGAN AKUN STANDAR (BAS) ENDPOINTS
  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

  async getAkun(params?: {
    search?: string;
    kategori?: string;
    kode3digit?: string;
    page?: number;
    limit?: number;
    sortBy?: 'kode' | 'uraian' | 'no';
    sortOrder?: 'asc' | 'desc';
  }): Promise<ApiResponse<AkunBelanja[]>> {
    const searchParams = new URLSearchParams();
    if (params?.search) searchParams.set('search', params.search);
    if (params?.kategori) searchParams.set('kategori', params.kategori);
    if (params?.kode3digit) searchParams.set('kode3digit', params.kode3digit);
    if (params?.page) searchParams.set('page', params.page.toString());
    if (params?.limit) searchParams.set('limit', params.limit.toString());
    if (params?.sortBy) searchParams.set('sortBy', params.sortBy);
    if (params?.sortOrder) searchParams.set('sortOrder', params.sortOrder);

    const query = searchParams.toString();
    return this.fetch<ApiResponse<AkunBelanja[]>>(`/api/referensi/akun${query ? `?${query}` : ''}`);
  }

  async getAkunByKode(kode: string): Promise<ApiResponse<AkunBelanja | null>> {
    return this.fetch<ApiResponse<AkunBelanja | null>>(`/api/referensi/akun/${kode}`);
  }

  async getKategoriList(): Promise<ApiResponse<string[]>> {
    return this.fetch<ApiResponse<string[]>>('/api/referensi/akun/kategori/list');
  }

  async getAkunSummary(): Promise<ApiResponse<{ totalAkun: number; byKategori: { kategori: string; count: number }[] }>> {
    return this.fetch<ApiResponse<{ totalAkun: number; byKategori: { kategori: string; count: number }[] }>>('/api/referensi/akun/summary');
  }

  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  // PEJABAT ENDPOINTS
  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

  async getPejabat(): Promise<ApiResponse<Pejabat[]>> {
    return this.fetch<ApiResponse<Pejabat[]>>('/api/referensi/pejabat');
  }

  async getPejabatAktif(): Promise<ApiResponse<Pejabat[]>> {
    return this.fetch<ApiResponse<Pejabat[]>>('/api/referensi/pejabat/aktif');
  }

  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  // SBK ENDPOINTS
  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

  async getSbk(): Promise<ApiResponse<Sbk[]>> {
    return this.fetch<ApiResponse<Sbk[]>>('/api/referensi/sbk');
  }

  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  // HEALTH CHECK
  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

  async healthCheck(): Promise<ApiResponse<{ timestamp: string; database: string }>> {
    return this.fetch<ApiResponse<{ timestamp: string; database: string }>>('/api/referensi/health');
  }
}

// Export singleton instance
export const apiService = new ApiService(API_BASE_URL);

// Helper functions
export function getAkunByKode(kode6Digit: string): BaganAkunStandar | undefined {
  return baganAkunStandar.find(ak => ak.kodeAkun6Digit === kode6Digit);
}

export function getAkunByKelompok(kategori: string): BaganAkunStandar[] {
  return baganAkunStandar.filter(ak => ak.kategori === kategori);
}

export function searchAkun(query: string): BaganAkunStandar[] {
  const q = query.toLowerCase();
  return baganAkunStandar.filter(ak =>
    ak.kodeAkun6Digit.includes(q) ||
    ak.uraianAkun.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
    ak.penggunaanSingkat.toLowerCase().includes(q)
  );
}

=== FILE: apps/web/src/data/sbmService.ts ===
// src/data/sbmService.ts
// Service pemroses data SBM & Database Referensi

export interface SbmDatabaseItem {
  id: number;
  kode_tabel: string;
  halaman: string;
  kategori: string;
  uraian: string;
  provinsi_kota: string;
  satuan: string;
  besaran: number | null;
  keterangan: string | null;
  raw_data: string;
}

let cachedItems: SbmDatabaseItem[] | null = null;

/**
 * Mengambil semua data SBM dari database JSON secara asynchronous.
 * Menghindari pembebanan ukuran bundle awal web.
 */
export async function getSbmDatabaseItems(): Promise<SbmDatabaseItem[]> {
  if (cachedItems) return cachedItems;

  try {
    const data = await import("./sbmData.json");
    cachedItems = (data.default || data) as SbmDatabaseItem[];
    return cachedItems;
  } catch (err) {
    console.error("Gagal memuat sbmData.json:", err);
    return [];
  }
}

/**
 * Mencari data SBM berdasarkan kata kunci pencarian.
 */
export async function searchSbmData(query: string): Promise<SbmDatabaseItem[]> {
  const items = await getSbmDatabaseItems();
  if (!query || query.trim() === "") return items;

  const q = query.toLowerCase().trim();
  return items.filter((item) =>
    item.uraian.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
    item.kode_tabel.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
    item.kategori.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
    item.raw_data.toLowerCase().includes(q)
  );
}

/**
 * Mengambil data SBM berdasarkan kode tabel (misal: 'T01_P004', 'T82_P098')
 */
export async function getSbmByTableCode(kodeTabel: string): Promise<SbmDatabaseItem[]> {
  const items = await getSbmDatabaseItems();
  return items.filter(
    (item) => item.kode_tabel.toLowerCase() === kodeTabel.toLowerCase()
  );
}

// Data Standar Biaya Masukan (SBM) TA 2026 berdasarkan PMK Nomor 32 Tahun 2025

import rawSbmData from "./sbmData.json";
import rawSbmTables from "./sbmTables.json";

export interface SbmItem {
  id: string;
  kodeTabel: string;
  halaman: string;
  kategori: "Lampiran I (Batas Tertinggi)" | "Lampiran II (Dapat Dilampaui)";
  jenisTabel: string;
  subkategori?: string;
  uraian: string;
  spesifikasi?: string;
  satuan: string;
  besaran: number;
  lampiran: "Lampiran I (Batas Tertinggi)" | "Lampiran II (Dapat Dilampaui)";
  dasarHukum: string;
  kolom?: string[];
}

export interface SbmTableMetadata {
  kodeTabel: string;
  page: string;
  lampiran: "Lampiran I (Batas Tertinggi)" | "Lampiran II (Dapat Dilampaui)";
  jenisTabel: string;
  itemCount: number;
}

// Full 86 SBM Table Metadata

  "Lampiran I (Batas Tertinggi)",

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// HELPER FUNCTIONS
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

export function getUnitKerjaByKlaster(klaster: string): UnitKerja[] {
  return unitKerja.filter(u => u.klaster === klaster);
}

export function getUnitKerjaByDeputi(deputi: string): UnitKerja[] {
  return unitKerja.filter(u => u.deputi === deputi);
}

export function getKROByUnit(unit: string): KelompokRincianOutput[] {
  return kelompokRincianOutput.filter(k => k.unit === unit);
}

export function getSasaranByProgram(programKode: string): SasaranProgram[] {
  return sasaranProgram.filter(sp => sp.kegiatan.includes(programKode) || sp.program.includes(programKode));
}

export function getIndikatorHierarchy(tahun?: number): any[] {
  return nomenklaturTujuan.map(tujuan => ({
    ...tujuan,
    children: sasaranStrategis.map(ss => ({
      ...ss,
      children: sasaranProgram
        .filter(sp => sp.indikator.length > 0)
        .map(sp => ({
          ...sp,
          children: sasaranKegiatan
            .filter(sk => sk.indikator.length > 0)
            .map(sk => ({
              ...sk,
              children: sk.indikator.map(ind => ({
                ...ind,
                target2027: ind.target[tahun || 2027],
              })),
            })),
        })),
    })),
  }));
}

import {
  FileText,
  TrendingUp,
  Users,
  DollarSign,
  CheckCircle,
  Clock,
  AlertCircle,
  BarChart3,
  Shield,
  Layers,

  BookOpenCheck,
  Calculator,
  Scale
} from "lucide-react";
import { Link } from "react-router-dom";

// ── Stat Card ──────────────────────────────────────────────
function StatCard({
  icon: Icon,
  label,
  value,
  sub,
  color,
  link,
}: {
  icon: React.ComponentType<{ className?: string }>;
  label: string;
  value: string;
  sub: string;
  color: string;
  link?: string;
}) {
  const content = (
    <div className="aksi-card p-5 flex gap-4 items-start hover:border-[var(--primary)] transition-all">
      <div className={`p-3 rounded-xl flex-shrink-0 ${color}`}>
        <Icon className="h-5 w-5" />
      </div>
      <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
        <p className="text-xs text-[var(--text-muted)] font-medium">{label}</p>
        <p className="text-2xl font-bold text-[var(--text)] mt-0.5 tabular-nums">{value}</p>
        <p className="text-xs text-[var(--text-muted)] mt-0.5 flex items-center justify-between">
          <span>{sub}</span>
          {link && <ArrowUpRight className="h-3 w-3 text-[var(--primary)] inline ml-1" />}
        </p>
      </div>
    </div>
  );

  return link ? <Link to={link}>{content}</Link> : content;
}

// ── Status Row ──────────────────────────────────────────────
function StatusRow({
  label,
  count,
  icon: Icon,
  color,
  bg,
  link,
}: {
  label: string;
  count: string;
  icon: React.ComponentType<{ className?: string }>;
  color: string;
  bg: string;
  link?: string;
}) {
  const row = (
    <div className="flex items-center justify-between py-2.5 border-b border-[var(--border)] last:border-0 hover:bg-[var(--accent)]/30 px-1 rounded-lg transition-colors">
      <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
        <span className={`p-1.5 rounded-lg ${bg}`}>
          <Icon className={`h-3.5 w-3.5 ${color}`} />
        </span>
        <span className="text-xs md:text-sm text-[var(--text)] font-medium">{label}</span>
      </div>
      <span className="text-xs font-semibold px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-[var(--accent)] text-[var(--text)]">{count}</span>
    </div>
  );

  return link ? <Link to={link}>{row}</Link> : row;
}

                <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                  <span className="text-xs text-[var(--text-muted)] font-medium">Baris per halaman:</span>
                  <select
                    value={sbmRowsPerPage}
                    onChange={(e) => {
                      setSbmRowsPerPage(Number(e.target.value));
                      setSbmCurrentPage(1);
                    }}
                    className="px-3 py-1 text-xs rounded-xl border border-[var(--border)] bg-[var(--accent)] text-[var(--text)] font-bold focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[var(--primary)] cursor-pointer"
                  >
                    <option value={10}>10 baris</option>
                    <option value={20}>20 baris</option>
                    <option value={50}>50 baris</option>
                    <option value={100}>100 baris</option>
                    <option value={200}>200 baris</option>
                  </select>

                  <span className="text-xs text-[var(--text-muted)]">
                    Menampilkan {filteredSbmList.length > 0 ? (sbmCurrentPage - 1) * sbmRowsPerPage + 1 : 0} -{" "}
                    {Math.min(sbmCurrentPage * sbmRowsPerPage, filteredSbmList.length)} dari{" "}
                    <strong className="text-[var(--text)]">{filteredSbmList.length}</strong> data SBM
                  </span>
                </div>

                <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                  <button
                    onClick={() => setSbmCurrentPage(1)}
                    disabled={sbmCurrentPage === 1}
                    className="px-2.5 py-1 text-xs font-semibold rounded-lg border border-[var(--border)] bg-[var(--card)] disabled:opacity-40 hover:bg-[var(--accent)] cursor-pointer"
                  >
                    « First
                  </button>
                  <button
                    onClick={() => setSbmCurrentPage((p) => Math.max(1, p - 1))}
                    disabled={sbmCurrentPage === 1}
                    className="px-2.5 py-1 text-xs font-semibold rounded-lg border border-[var(--border)] bg-[var(--card)] disabled:opacity-40 hover:bg-[var(--accent)] cursor-pointer"
                  >
                    ‹ Prev
                  </button>
                  <span className="px-3 py-1 text-xs font-bold text-[var(--primary)] bg-[var(--primary-bg)]/20 rounded-lg">
                    {sbmCurrentPage} / {sbmTotalPages}
                  </span>
                  <button
                    onClick={() => setSbmCurrentPage((p) => Math.min(sbmTotalPages, p + 1))}
                    disabled={sbmCurrentPage >= sbmTotalPages}
                    className="px-2.5 py-1 text-xs font-semibold rounded-lg border border-[var(--border)] bg-[var(--card)] disabled:opacity-40 hover:bg-[var(--accent)] cursor-pointer"
                  >
                    Next ›
                  </button>
                  <button
                    onClick={() => setSbmCurrentPage(sbmTotalPages)}
                    disabled={sbmCurrentPage >= sbmTotalPages}
                    className="px-2.5 py-1 text-xs font-semibold rounded-lg border border-[var(--border)] bg-[var(--card)] disabled:opacity-40 hover:bg-[var(--accent)] cursor-pointer"
                  >
                    Last »
                  </button>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="aksi-card overflow-hidden">
                <div className="overflow-x-auto">
                  <table className="w-full text-left text-xs">
                    <thead className="bg-[var(--accent)] text-[var(--text-muted)] font-bold border-b border-[var(--border)]">
                      <tr>
                        <th className="py-2.5 px-3">Ketentuan SBM</th>
                        <th className="py-2.5 px-3">Jenis Tabel</th>
                        <th className="py-2.5 px-3">Uraian Komponen Biaya SBM</th>
                        <th className="py-2.5 px-3">Satuan</th>
                        <th className="py-2.5 px-3 text-right">Besaran / Tarif (Rp)</th>
                      </tr>
                    </thead>
                    <tbody className="divide-y divide-[var(--border)]">
                      {paginatedSbmList.length > 0 ? (
                        paginatedSbmList.map((item) => (
                          <tr key={item.id} className="hover:bg-[var(--accent)]/40 transition-colors">
                            <td className="py-2.5 px-3 whitespace-nowrap">
                              <span
                                className={`text-[0.68rem] px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full font-semibold ${
                                  item.kategori.includes("Batas Tertinggi")
                                    ? "bg-red-50 dark:bg-red-950/40 text-red-700 dark:text-red-300 border border-red-200 dark:border-red-800"
                                    : "bg-blue-50 dark:bg-blue-950/40 text-blue-700 dark:text-blue-300 border border-blue-200 dark:border-blue-800"
                                }`}
                              >
                                {item.kategori.includes("Batas Tertinggi") ? "Lampiran I" : "Lampiran II"}
                              </span>
                            </td>
                            <td className="py-2.5 px-3 font-semibold text-[var(--text)] max-w-xs">
                              <div className="text-[0.75rem]">{item.jenisTabel}</div>
                              <div className="text-[0.65rem] text-[var(--text-muted)] font-mono">
                                {item.halaman} ({item.kodeTabel})
                              </div>
                            </td>
                            <td className="py-2.5 px-3 font-medium text-[var(--text)]">
                              <div>{item.uraian}</div>
                              {item.spesifikasi && (
                                <div className="text-[0.65rem] text-[var(--text-muted)] italic">{item.spesifikasi}</div>
                              )}
                            </td>
                            <td className="py-2.5 px-3 whitespace-nowrap font-bold text-[var(--text-muted)]">
                              {item.satuan}
                            </td>
                            <td className="py-2.5 px-3 text-right font-bold text-[var(--primary)] tabular-nums whitespace-nowrap">
                              Rp {item.besaran.toLocaleString("id-ID")}
                            </td>
                          </tr>
                        ))
                      ) : (
                        <tr>
                          <td colSpan={5} className="py-8 text-center text-[var(--text-muted)]">
                            Tidak ada data SBM yang sesuai filter pencarian.
                          </td>
                        </tr>
                      )}
                    </tbody>
                  </table>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          {path === "/standar-biaya/sbk" && (
            <div className="space-y-4">
              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
                {mockSbk.map((sbk) => (
                  <div key={sbk.kode} className="aksi-card p-5 space-y-2 border-t-4 border-t-[var(--primary)]">
                    <div className="flex justify-between items-start">
                      <span className="badge badge-primary">{sbk.kode}</span>
                      <span className="text-[0.65rem] text-[var(--text-muted)] font-mono">{sbk.satuan}</span>
                    </div>
                    <h3 className="font-bold text-sm text-[var(--text)]">{sbk.nama}</h3>
                    <p className="text-xs text-[var(--text-muted)]">{sbk.keterangan}</p>
                    <div className="pt-3 mt-2 border-t border-[var(--border)] flex justify-between items-center">
                      <span className="text-xs text-[var(--text-muted)]">Plafon Maksimal:</span>
                      <span className="text-base font-black text-[var(--primary)] tabular-nums">
                        Rp {sbk.paguMaks.toLocaleString("id-ID")}
                      </span>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
          3. MODUL MASTER: BAGAN AKUN STANDAR (BAS 6 DIGIT) - LENGKAP
         ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */}
      {path === "/referensi/bas" && (
        <div className="space-y-4">
          <div className="aksi-card p-5 border-l-4 border-l-[var(--primary)] bg-gradient-to-r from-[var(--card)] to-[var(--primary-bg)]/15">
            <div className="flex flex-col md:flex-row justify-between items-start md:items-center gap-3">
              <div>
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-1">
                  <span className="badge badge-primary text-[0.65rem] font-bold">BAS 6 DIGIT</span>
                  <span className="text-xs text-[var(--text-muted)]">Klasifikasi Akun Penganggaran Belanja SAKTI</span>
                </div>
                <h2 className="text-base font-bold text-[var(--text)]">Bagan Akun Standar (BAS) - Referensi Lengkap</h2>
                <p className="text-xs text-[var(--text-muted)] mt-0.5">
                  {fullBaganAkunStandar.length} Kode Akun untuk Klasifikasi Belanja Pemerintah
                </p>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-6 gap-3">
            {kategoriAkun.map((kat) => (
              <button
                key={kat.value}
                onClick={() => setBasKategoriFilter(kat.value === basKategoriFilter ? "Semua" : kat.value)}
                className={`aksi-card p-3 text-left transition-all ${
                  basKategoriFilter === kat.value
                    ? "border-[var(--primary)] bg-[var(--primary-bg)]/20"
                    : "hover:border-[var(--primary)]/50"
                }`}
              >
                <span className="text-[0.65rem] font-bold text-[var(--text-muted)]">{kat.label}</span>
                <p className="text-lg font-black text-[var(--primary)] mt-1">{kat.count}</p>
                <span className="text-[0.65rem] text-[var(--text-muted)]">akun</span>
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>

          <div className="aksi-card p-4">
            <div className="flex flex-col lg:flex-row items-center justify-between gap-3">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2 w-full lg:w-auto">
                <div className="relative w-full lg:w-80">
                  <Search className="absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 h-4 w-4 text-[var(--text-muted)]" />
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    value={basSearch}
                    onChange={(e) => setBasSearch(e.target.value)}
                    placeholder="Cari kode atau nama akun..."
                    className="w-full pl-9 pr-4 py-1.5 text-xs rounded-xl border border-[var(--border)] bg-[var(--accent)] text-[var(--text)] focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[var(--primary)]"
                  />
                </div>

                <select
                  value={basKategoriFilter}
                  onChange={(e) => setBasKategoriFilter(e.target.value)}
                  className="px-2.5 py-1.5 text-xs rounded-xl border border-[var(--border)] bg-[var(--card)] text-[var(--text)] focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[var(--primary)]"
                >
                  <option value="Semua">Semua Kategori</option>
                  {kategoriAkun.map((kat) => (
                    <option key={kat.value} value={kat.value}>
                      {kat.label}
                    </option>
                  ))}
                </select>
              </div>

              <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs text-[var(--text-muted)]">
                <span>
                  Ditemukan: <strong className="text-[var(--text)]">{fullBaganAkunStandar.length} akun</strong>
                </span>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="aksi-card overflow-hidden">
            <div className="overflow-x-auto">
              <table className="w-full text-left text-xs">
                <thead className="bg-[var(--accent)] text-[var(--text-muted)] font-bold border-b border-[var(--border)]">
                  <tr>
                    <th className="py-2.5 px-3 w-24">No</th>
                    <th className="py-2.5 px-3 w-28">Kode 6 Digit</th>
                    <th className="py-2.5 px-3">Uraian Akun Belanja</th>
                    <th className="py-2.5 px-3 w-40">Kelompok (3 Digit)</th>
                    <th className="py-2.5 px-3 w-36">Kategori</th>
                    <th className="py-2.5 px-3">Penggunaan Singkat</th>
                  </tr>
                </thead>
                <tbody className="divide-y divide-[var(--border)]">
                  {fullBaganAkunStandar
                    .filter((ak) => {
                      const matchSearch =
                        !basSearch ||
                        ak.kodeAkun6Digit.includes(basSearch.toUpperCase()) ||
                        ak.uraianAkun.toLowerCase().includes(basSearch.toLowerCase()) ||
                        ak.penggunaanSingkat.toLowerCase().includes(basSearch.toLowerCase());
                      const matchKategori = basKategoriFilter === "Semua" || ak.kategori === basKategoriFilter;
                      return matchSearch && matchKategori;
                    })
                    .map((ak) => (
                      <tr key={ak.id} className="hover:bg-[var(--accent)]/40 transition-colors">
                        <td className="py-2.5 px-3 text-[var(--text-muted)]">{ak.no}</td>
                        <td className="py-2.5 px-3 font-mono font-bold text-sm text-[var(--primary)]">{ak.kodeAkun6Digit}</td>
                        <td className="py-2.5 px-3 font-semibold text-[var(--text)]">{ak.uraianAkun}</td>
                        <td className="py-2.5 px-3">
                          <span className="font-mono text-[0.7rem]">{ak.kodeAkun3Digit}</span>
                          <div className="text-[0.65rem] text-[var(--text-muted)] truncate max-w-[200px]">
                            {ak.namaAkun3Digit}
                          </div>
                        </td>
                        <td className="py-2.5 px-3">
                          <span
                            className={`inline-flex items-center text-[0.68rem] px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full font-semibold ${
                              ak.kategori === "Belanja Pegawai"
                                ? "bg-purple-50 text-purple-700 dark:bg-purple-950/40 dark:text-purple-300"
                                : ak.kategori === "Belanja Barang"
                                ? "bg-blue-50 text-blue-700 dark:bg-blue-950/40 dark:text-blue-300"
                                : ak.kategori === "Belanja Jasa"
                                ? "bg-cyan-50 text-cyan-700 dark:bg-cyan-950/40 dark:text-cyan-300"
                                : ak.kategori === "Belanja Pemeliharaan"
                                ? "bg-amber-50 text-amber-700 dark:bg-amber-950/40 dark:text-amber-300"
                                : ak.kategori === "Belanja Perjalanan"
                                ? "bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 dark:bg-emerald-950/40 dark:text-emerald-300"
                                : "bg-gray-50 text-gray-700 dark:bg-gray-950/40 dark:text-gray-300"
                            }`}
                          >
                            {ak.kategori}
                          </span>
                        </td>
                        <td className="py-2.5 px-3 text-[var(--text-muted)] max-w-md">{ak.penggunaanSingkat}</td>
                      </tr>
                    ))}
                </tbody>
              </table>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
          4. REFERENSI INFORMASI KINERJA: VISI & MISI
         ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */}
      {path === "/referensi/visi-misi" && (
        <div className="space-y-4">
          <div className="aksi-card p-6 border-l-4 border-l-[var(--primary)] bg-gradient-to-br from-[var(--card)] to-[var(--primary-bg)]/10">
            <span className="text-[0.65rem] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-[var(--primary)]">
              VISI PPATK 2025-2029
            </span>
            <p className="text-sm font-semibold text-[var(--primary)] italic mt-2 leading-relaxed">
              "{rawRenstraNomenklatur.visi}"
            </p>
          </div>

          <div className="space-y-3">
            <h3 className="text-sm font-bold text-[var(--text)]">Misi PPATK</h3>
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-3">
              {rawRenstraNomenklatur.misi.map((misiStr, idx) => (
                <div key={idx} className="aksi-card p-4 flex items-start gap-3">
                  <div className="w-8 h-8 rounded-full bg-[var(--primary-bg)] text-[var(--primary)] flex items-center justify-center font-bold text-sm flex-shrink-0">
                    {idx + 1}
                  </div>
                  <p className="text-xs text-[var(--text)] leading-relaxed">{misiStr}</p>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="aksi-card p-5">
            <h3 className="text-sm font-bold text-[var(--text)] mb-3">Tujuan PPATK</h3>
            <div className="p-4 rounded-xl bg-[var(--accent)]/50 border border-[var(--border)]">
              {rawRenstraNomenklatur.tujuan.map((tujuanStr, idx) => (
                <div key={idx}>
                  <div className="flex items-start gap-2 mb-2">
                    <span className="badge badge-primary">TUJUAN 0.{idx}</span>
                  </div>
                  <p className="text-xs text-[var(--text)] leading-relaxed mb-3">{tujuanStr}</p>
                  {rawRenstraNomenklatur.indikatorTujuan.map((ind) => (
                    <div key={ind.nama} className="bg-[var(--card)] p-3 rounded-lg border border-[var(--border)]">
                      <div className="text-xs font-semibold text-[var(--text)] mb-2">{ind.nama}</div>
                      <div className="grid grid-cols-5 gap-2 text-center">
                        {[2025, 2026, 2027, 2028, 2029].map((tahun) => {
                          const key = `t${tahun}` as keyof typeof ind;
                          return (
                            <div key={tahun} className="p-2 rounded bg-[var(--accent)]">
                              <div className="text-[0.65rem] text-[var(--text-muted)]">{tahun}</div>
                              <div className="font-bold text-[var(--primary)]">{ind[key]}</div>
                            </div>
                          );
                        })}
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  ))}
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
          5. SUBMENU KHUSUS: VISUALISASI SASARAN KINERJA (STEP-BY-STEP DRILL-DOWN)
         ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */}
      {path === "/referensi/visualisasi-sasaran-kinerja" && (
        <div className="space-y-6">
          <div className="aksi-card p-5 border-l-4 border-l-[var(--primary)] bg-gradient-to-r from-[var(--card)] to-[var(--primary-bg)]/15">
            <div className="flex flex-col md:flex-row justify-between items-start md:items-center gap-3">
              <div>
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-1">
                  <span className="badge badge-primary text-[0.65rem] font-bold">DIAGRAM DUKMAN & KRISNA</span>
                  <span className="text-xs text-[var(--text-muted)]">Visualisasi Hierarki Step-by-Step Perka PPATK</span>
                </div>
                <h2 className="text-base font-bold text-[var(--text)]">Visualisasi Sasaran Kinerja PPATK</h2>
                <p className="text-xs text-[var(--text-muted)] mt-0.5">
                  Klik pada setiap level diagram untuk membuka cabang hierarki di bawahnya (Drill-Down Bertahap sampai RO)
                </p>
              </div>
              <Link
                to="/referensi/informasi-kinerja"
                className="px-4 py-2 text-xs font-semibold rounded-xl bg-[var(--primary)] text-white hover:opacity-90 flex items-center gap-1.5 shadow-sm transition-opacity"
              >
                <span>Buka Tabel Informasi Kinerja (Drill-Down RO)</span>
                <ArrowUpRight className="h-4 w-4" />
              </Link>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Interactive Step-by-Step Cascading Flowchart */}
          <div className="aksi-card p-6 space-y-6 overflow-x-auto">
            {/* Level 0: K/L (PPATK) */}
            <div className="flex flex-col items-center">
              <button
                onClick={() => setVisibleDiagramLevel(visibleDiagramLevel >= 1 ? 0 : 1)}
                className="w-full max-w-xl p-4 text-center rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-r from-slate-900 via-blue-950 to-slate-900 text-white shadow-lg border border-blue-400/40 cursor-pointer hover:opacity-95 transition-all"
              >
                <span className="text-[0.65rem] uppercase font-bold tracking-widest text-blue-300 block mb-1">
                  LEVEL 0 · KEMENTERIAN / LEMBAGA
                </span>
                <h3 className="text-base font-black tracking-wide">
                  078 - PUSAT PELAPORAN DAN ANALISIS TRANSAKSI KEUANGAN (PPATK)
                </h3>
                <span className="text-[0.68rem] text-blue-200 block mt-1">
                  {visibleDiagramLevel >= 1 ? "▲ Klik untuk menutup cabang Level 1" : "▼ Klik untuk membuka Level 1 (Sasaran Strategis)"}
                </span>
              </button>

              {visibleDiagramLevel >= 1 && <div className="w-0.5 h-6 bg-[var(--primary)] opacity-40 my-1" />}
            </div>

            {/* Level 1: SASARAN STRATEGIS */}
            {visibleDiagramLevel >= 1 && (
              <div className="space-y-4 flex flex-col items-center">
                <div className="text-center">
                  <span className="text-[0.68rem] font-bold text-[var(--primary)] uppercase tracking-wider bg-[var(--primary-bg)]/30 px-3.5 py-1 rounded-full">
                    LEVEL 1 · SASARAN STRATEGIS (PERKA PPATK)
                  </span>
                </div>

                <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4 w-full max-w-4xl">
                  {/* SS 01 */}
                  <button
                    onClick={() => setVisibleDiagramLevel(visibleDiagramLevel >= 2 ? 1 : 2)}
                    className={`p-4 rounded-xl border-2 text-left transition-all cursor-pointer ${
                      visibleDiagramLevel >= 2
                        ? "border-[var(--primary)] bg-[var(--primary-bg)]/20 shadow-md"
                        : "border-[var(--border)] bg-[var(--card)] hover:border-[var(--primary)]/60"
                    }`}
                  >
                    <span className="badge badge-primary font-mono text-xs mb-1">SS 01</span>
                    <h4 className="font-bold text-xs text-[var(--text)] leading-snug">
                      01 - Meningkatnya Efektivitas Kinerja PPATK dalam Pencegahan dan Pemberantasan TPPU, TPPT dan PPSPM
                    </h4>
                    <p className="text-[0.7rem] text-[var(--text-muted)] mt-1">
                      Mengampu Program Utama Teknis (078.01.BE) & 5 Kegiatan Utama.
                    </p>
                    <div className="mt-2 text-[0.68rem] font-bold text-[var(--primary)] flex items-center gap-1">
                      <span>{visibleDiagramLevel >= 2 ? "▲ Tutup Cabang Program BE" : "▼ Klik untuk Drill-Down ke Program BE"}</span>
                    </div>
                  </button>

                  {/* SS 02 */}
                  <button
                    onClick={() => setVisibleDiagramLevel(visibleDiagramLevel >= 2 ? 1 : 2)}
                    className={`p-4 rounded-xl border-2 text-left transition-all cursor-pointer ${
                      visibleDiagramLevel >= 2
                        ? "border-[var(--primary)] bg-[var(--primary-bg)]/20 shadow-md"
                        : "border-[var(--border)] bg-[var(--card)] hover:border-[var(--primary)]/60"
                    }`}
                  >
                    <span className="badge badge-gray font-mono text-xs mb-1">SS 02</span>
                    <h4 className="font-bold text-xs text-[var(--text)] leading-snug">
                      02 - Meningkatnya Kinerja Revitalisasi Birokrasi PPATK (Dukungan Manajemen)
                    </h4>
                    <p className="text-[0.7rem] text-[var(--text-muted)] mt-1">
                      Mengampu Program Dukungan Manajemen (078.01.WA) & 5 Kegiatan Dukman (Inspektorat, Biro, Kemitraan).
                    </p>
                    <div className="mt-2 text-[0.68rem] font-bold text-[var(--primary)] flex items-center gap-1">
                      <span>{visibleDiagramLevel >= 2 ? "▲ Tutup Cabang Program WA" : "▼ Klik untuk Drill-Down ke Program WA (Dukman)"}</span>
                    </div>
                  </button>
                </div>

                {visibleDiagramLevel >= 2 && <div className="w-0.5 h-6 bg-[var(--primary)] opacity-40 my-1" />}
              </div>
            )}

            {/* Level 2: SASARAN PROGRAM & PROGRAM DUKMAN / BE */}
            {visibleDiagramLevel >= 2 && (
              <div className="space-y-4 flex flex-col items-center">
                <div className="text-center">
                  <span className="text-[0.68rem] font-bold text-[var(--primary)] uppercase tracking-wider bg-[var(--primary-bg)]/30 px-3.5 py-1 rounded-full">
                    LEVEL 2 · PROGRAM & SASARAN PROGRAM (SP)
                  </span>
                </div>

                <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-2 gap-4 w-full max-w-5xl">
                  {/* Program BE Card */}
                  <div className="p-4 rounded-xl border-2 border-blue-500/40 bg-gradient-to-b from-blue-50/20 to-[var(--card)] dark:from-blue-950/20 dark:to-[var(--card)] space-y-3">
                    <div className="flex justify-between items-start">
                      <span className="badge badge-primary font-mono text-xs">078.01.BE</span>
                      <span className="text-[0.65rem] px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-blue-100 text-blue-700 dark:bg-blue-900/40 dark:text-blue-300 font-bold">

                        Program Dukungan Manajemen
                      </span>
                    </div>
                    <h4 className="font-bold text-xs text-[var(--text)] leading-snug">
                      Program Dukungan Manajemen (Dukman)

                    <div className="p-2.5 rounded-lg bg-[var(--accent)] text-[0.72rem] space-y-1">

                      <span>{visibleDiagramLevel >= 3 ? "▲ Tutup Level Kegiatan Dukman" : "▼ Drill-Down ke Kegiatan & KRO/RO (WA Dukman)"}</span>

                {visibleDiagramLevel >= 3 && <div className="w-0.5 h-6 bg-[var(--primary)] opacity-40 my-1" />}
              </div>
            )}

            {/* Level 3: KEGIATAN & SASARAN KEGIATAN */}
            {visibleDiagramLevel >= 3 && (
              <div className="space-y-4 flex flex-col items-center">
                <div className="text-center">
                  <span className="text-[0.68rem] font-bold text-[var(--primary)] uppercase tracking-wider bg-[var(--primary-bg)]/30 px-3.5 py-1 rounded-full">
                    LEVEL 3 · KEGIATAN & SASARAN KEGIATAN (DUKMAN & BE)
                  </span>
                </div>

                  {[
                    { kode: "3374", nama: "Pengawasan Internal PPATK", unit: "PEKA / Inspektorat", sasaran: "01-Meningkatnya efektivitas pengawasan internal PPATK" },
                    { kode: "3375", nama: "Pengelolaan Perencanaan & Keuangan", unit: "BINCANG / Biro Renkeu", sasaran: "01-Perencanaan Penganggaran & 02-Keuangan Akuntabel" },

                    { kode: "3377", nama: "Ketatausahaan & Kerumahtanggaan", unit: "BIRU / Biro Umum", sasaran: "01-Layanan Umum PPATK & 02-Kearsipan PPATK" },
                    { kode: "8004", nama: "Hubmas & Kemitraan APU PPT", unit: "BERMITRA / Pusat Kemitraan", sasaran: "01-Layanan Humas & 02-Pemberdayaan Kemitraan" },
                    { kode: "3365", nama: "Pendidikan & Pelatihan APU PPT", unit: "PATIH / Pusdiklat", sasaran: "01-Kompetensi SDM & 02-Kompetensi APH" },
                  ].map((keg) => (

                      <div className="flex justify-between items-start">
                        <span className="badge badge-primary font-mono text-xs">{keg.kode}</span>

                      <button
                        onClick={() => setVisibleDiagramLevel(visibleDiagramLevel >= 4 ? 3 : 4)}

                      >
                        {visibleDiagramLevel >= 4 ? "▲ Tutup KRO & RO" : "▼ Drill-Down ke KRO & RO (Rincian Output)"}

                  ))}
                </div>

                {visibleDiagramLevel >= 4 && <div className="w-0.5 h-6 bg-[var(--primary)] opacity-40 my-1" />}
              </div>
            )}

            {/* Level 4: KRO & RINCIAN OUTPUT (RO) */}
            {visibleDiagramLevel >= 4 && (
              <div className="space-y-4 flex flex-col items-center">
                <div className="text-center">
                  <span className="text-[0.68rem] font-bold text-[var(--primary)] uppercase tracking-wider bg-[var(--primary-bg)]/30 px-3.5 py-1 rounded-full">
                    LEVEL 4 · KELOMPOK RINCIAN OUTPUT (KRO) & RINCIAN OUTPUT (RO)
                  </span>
                </div>

                <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-3 w-full max-w-6xl">
                  {[
                    { kro: "EBA - Layanan Dukungan Manajemen Internal", ro: "994 - Layanan Perkantoran, 962 - Layanan Umum, Z06 - Layanan BMN" },
                    { kro: "EBB - Layanan Sarana dan Prasarana Internal", ro: "971 - Layanan Prasarana Internal, 951 - Layanan Sarana Internal" },
                    { kro: "EBC - Layanan Manajemen SDM Internal", ro: "954 - Layanan Manajemen SDM, 996 - Layanan Diklat Pegawai" },
                    { kro: "EBD - Layanan Manajemen Kinerja Internal", ro: "952 - Layanan Perencanaan, 955 - Manajemen Keuangan, 965 - Audit Internal" },
                  ].map((item, idx) => (
                    <div key={idx} className="p-3 rounded-xl border border-purple-300 dark:border-purple-800 bg-purple-50/20 dark:bg-purple-950/20 space-y-1.5">

                    </div>

        </div>
      )}

      {/* ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
          6. SUBMENU UTAMA: INFORMASI KINERJA (Drill-Up & Drill-Down RO)
         ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */}
      {(path === "/referensi/informasi-kinerja" ||
        path === "/referensi/output-kro" ||
        path === "/referensi/komponen") && (
        <div className="space-y-6">
          {/* Header Banner */}
          <div className="aksi-card p-5 border-l-4 border-l-[var(--primary)] bg-gradient-to-r from-[var(--card)] to-[var(--primary-bg)]/15">
            <div className="flex flex-col md:flex-row justify-between items-start md:items-center gap-3">
              <div>
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-1">
                  <span className="badge badge-primary text-[0.65rem] font-bold">REKAP SASARAN RENJA PPATK (ALL)</span>
                  <span className="text-xs text-[var(--text-muted)]">Target Kinerja 2027–2030 (Drill-Down sampai Level RO)</span>

                  Eksplorasi data sasaran kinerja, indikator, target 5 tahunan (2025-2030), dan rincian output kegiatan.
                </p>

                    activeTabKinerja === "sasaran"
                      ? "bg-[var(--primary)] text-white shadow"
                      : "text-[var(--text-muted)] hover:text-[var(--text)]"
                  }`}
                >
                  Hierarki Sasaran & RO (114)
                </button>
                <button
                  onClick={() => setActiveTabKinerja("komponen")}

                      ? "bg-[var(--primary)] text-white shadow"
                      : "text-[var(--text-muted)] hover:text-[var(--text)]"

                  Katalog Komponen (443)

                      setSelectedKegiatanFilter("Semua");
                    }}

                  >
                    <span>▲ Drill-Up ke Semua Program</span>
                  </button>

                <button

                <span className="text-xs text-[var(--text-muted)] font-medium">Baris per halaman:</span>

          {activeTabKinerja === "sasaran" && (
            <div className="space-y-4">

                            ? "border-emerald-500/30 bg-gradient-to-r from-emerald-50/10 to-[var(--card)]"

                            <button

                                <span className={`text-[0.65rem] px-2 py-0.5 rounded font-bold font-mono ${
                                  group.type === "SASARAN_PROGRAM"
                                    ? "bg-blue-100 text-blue-800 dark:bg-blue-950 dark:text-blue-300"
                                    : group.type === "SASARAN_KEGIATAN"
                                    ? "bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800 dark:bg-emerald-950 dark:text-emerald-300"
                                    : "bg-purple-100 text-purple-800 dark:bg-purple-950 dark:text-purple-300"

                                  {group.type.replace(/_/g, " ")}
                                </span>

                                {group.kegiatan && (

                              <span>{isExpanded ? "Tutup" : "Drill-Down ▾"}</span>
                            </button>

                        {isExpanded && (

                                <tr>
                                  <th className="py-2.5 px-4 w-12 text-center">No</th>
                                  <th className="py-2.5 px-3">Indikator Kinerja</th>
                                  <th className="py-2.5 px-2 text-center w-16">2025</th>
                                  <th className="py-2.5 px-2 text-center w-16">2026</th>
                                  <th className="py-2.5 px-2 text-center w-16 bg-[var(--primary-bg)]/20 text-[var(--primary)] font-black">
                                    2027
                                  </th>
                                  <th className="py-2.5 px-2 text-center w-16">2028</th>
                                  <th className="py-2.5 px-2 text-center w-16">2029</th>
                                  <th className="py-2.5 px-2 text-center w-16">2030</th>

                                {group.indicators.map((ind: any, iIdx: number) => (

                                    </td>

                                      {ind.target["2026"] || "-"}
                                    </td>

                      </div>
                    );
                  })}
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* ── TAB 2: KATALOG KOMPONEN LENGKAP (443 DATA) ── */}
          {activeTabKinerja === "komponen" && (

      {/* ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
          7. REFERENSI INFORMASI KINERJA: UNIT KERJA
         ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */}
      {path === "/referensi/unit-kerja" && (
        <div className="space-y-6">
          <div className="aksi-card p-5 border-l-4 border-l-[var(--primary)] bg-gradient-to-r from-[var(--card)] to-[var(--primary-bg)]/15">
            <div className="flex flex-col md:flex-row justify-between items-start md:items-center gap-3">
              <div>
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-1">
                  <span className="badge badge-primary text-[0.65rem] font-bold">STRUKTUR ORGANISASI PPATK</span>

                <h2 className="text-base font-bold text-[var(--text)]">Unit Kerja PPATK</h2>
                <p className="text-xs text-[var(--text-muted)] mt-0.5">
                  Daftar unit kerja di lingkungan PPATK
                </p>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="space-y-4">
            <h3 className="text-sm font-bold text-[var(--text)] flex items-center gap-2 border-b border-[var(--border)] pb-2">

            </h3>

            {[
              {

                units: rawUnitKerjaData.filter(
                  (u: any) => u.subcluster === "Deputi Bidang Analisis Transaksi Keuangan (ASA)"

                            : "bg-slate-100 text-slate-600"

                        <span
                          className={`w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full ${u.status === "Online" ? "bg-green-500" : "bg-slate-400"}`}

                        {u.status}
                      </span>
                    </td>
                    <td className="py-3 px-3 text-right">
                      <button
                        onClick={() => alert(`Kelola hak akses untuk ${u.nama}`)}
                        className="text-[var(--primary)] font-semibold hover:underline cursor-pointer"
                      >
                        Edit Izin
                      </button>
                    </td>
                  </tr>
                ))}
              </tbody>
            </table>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
          11. TAMPILAN MODUL UMUM LAINNYA (SETIA / PATIH / KAK / MONEV)
         ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */}
      {!path.startsWith("/rab") &&
        !path.startsWith("/renstra") &&
        !path.startsWith("/standar-biaya") &&
        !path.startsWith("/referensi/visi-misi") &&
        !path.startsWith("/referensi/visualisasi-sasaran-kinerja") &&
        !path.startsWith("/referensi/informasi-kinerja") &&
        !path.startsWith("/referensi/unit-kerja") &&
        !path.startsWith("/referensi/satuan-kerja") &&
        path !== "/referensi/bas" &&
        path !== "/referensi/pejabat" &&
        !path.startsWith("/admin/pengguna") &&
        !path.startsWith("/admin/peran") && (
          <div className="space-y-4">
            <div className="aksi-card p-6 border-l-4 border-l-[var(--primary)] bg-gradient-to-r from-[var(--card)] to-[var(--accent)]/30">

              <p className="text-xs text-[var(--text-muted)] mt-1">
                Dokumen resmi perencanaan terintegrasi dalam sistem AKSI PPATK Tahun Anggaran 2027.
              </p>
              <div className="mt-4 flex flex-wrap gap-2 text-xs">
                <span className="badge badge-primary">Eselon I: Sekretariat Utama (SETIA)</span>
                <span className="badge badge-gray">Eselon II: Pusdiklat APU PPT (PATIH)</span>
                <span className="badge badge-red">RO: Diklat Aparat Penegak Hukum (APH)</span>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="aksi-card p-8 text-center space-y-3">
              <FileSpreadsheet className="h-12 w-12 mx-auto text-[var(--primary)] opacity-80" />
              <h3 className="font-bold text-sm text-[var(--text)]">Formulir Kerja & Matriks Terhubung</h3>
              <p className="text-xs text-[var(--text-muted)] max-w-md mx-auto">
                Seluruh data pada menu ini langsung terkoneksi dengan <b>Renstra PPATK 2025–2029</b>, <b>Bagan Akun Standar</b>, serta rincian <b>Standar Biaya Keluaran (SBK)</b>.
              </p>
              <div className="pt-2 flex justify-center gap-3">
                <Link
                  to="/rab/input-rinci"
                  className="px-4 py-2 text-xs font-semibold rounded-xl bg-[var(--primary)] text-white hover:opacity-90 transition-opacity"
                >
                  Buka Input RAB Rinci ➜
                </Link>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}
    </div>
  );
}

import {
  FileText,
  TrendingUp,
  Users,
  DollarSign,
  CheckCircle,
  Clock,
  AlertCircle,
  BarChart3,
} from "lucide-react";

// ── Stat Card ──────────────────────────────────────────────
function StatCard({
  icon: Icon,
  label,
  value,
  sub,
  color,
}: {
  icon: React.ComponentType<{ className?: string }>;
  label: string;
  value: string;
  sub: string;
  color: string;
}) {
  return (
    <div className="aksi-card p-5 flex gap-4 items-start">
      <div className={`p-3 rounded-xl flex-shrink-0 ${color}`}>
        <Icon className="h-5 w-5" />
      </div>
      <div>
        <p className="text-xs text-[var(--text-muted)] font-medium">{label}</p>
        <p className="text-2xl font-bold text-[var(--text)] mt-0.5">{value}</p>
        <p className="text-xs text-[var(--text-muted)] mt-0.5">{sub}</p>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

// ── Status Row ──────────────────────────────────────────────
function StatusRow({
  label,
  count,
  icon: Icon,
  color,
  bg,
}: {
  label: string;
  count: number;
  icon: React.ComponentType<{ className?: string }>;
  color: string;
  bg: string;
}) {
  return (
    <div className="flex items-center justify-between py-2.5 border-b border-[var(--border)] last:border-0">
      <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
        <span className={`p-1.5 rounded-lg ${bg}`}>
          <Icon className={`h-3.5 w-3.5 ${color}`} />
        </span>
        <span className="text-sm text-[var(--text)]">{label}</span>
      </div>
      <span className="text-sm font-semibold text-[var(--text)]">{count}</span>
    </div>
  );
}
